actions.content:
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
API = ROOT / "backend/api/admin_scheduler_resync.py"
RANGE = ROOT / "backend/modules/comercial/resync_batch_jobs.py"
OPEN_JOB = ROOT / "backend/core/scheduler/jobs/sync_comercial_abiertas_v2_job.py"


def test_manual_real_detail_is_selective_again():
    text = API.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    block = text.split("async def _ejecutar_sync_real(", 1)[1]
    block = block.split("async def resolver_dependencias_sync(", 1)[0]
    assert "force_refresh=True" not in block
    assert "_ejecutar_backfill_detalle_iscam(" in block


def test_iscam_batch_reconciles_header_before_final_no_cuadra():
    text = API.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    block = text.split("def _run_iscam_detail_batch_job", 1)[1]
    block = block.split('@router.post("/resync/iscam-detail/jobs"', 1)[0]
    assert "NO_CUADRA_REVISAR" in block
    assert "_ejecutar_sync_real(" in block
    assert "HEADER_RESYNC_FAILED" in block


def test_range_waits_for_shared_lock_instead_of_fast_failing():
    text = RANGE.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "LOCK_WAIT_SECONDS" in text
    assert "JOB_WAITING_LOCK" in text
    assert "LOCK_WAIT_TIMEOUT" in text
    assert "waiting[\"current_phase\"] = \"WAITING_LOCK\"" in text


def test_protected_open_sales_job_is_not_part_of_this_fix():
    text = OPEN_JOB.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "sync_comercial_abiertas_v2" in text

constraints: No modificar la logica de ventas abiertas
No ocultar NO_CUADRA_REVISAR: intentar primero reconciliacion oficial del encabezado del mismo dia
No forzar refresh del detalle ya conciliado
